versions.changelog: Ownership migrated to the trustgrowth org; content unchanged from 1.0.0

- Initial release of the authority-review skill.
- Provides assessments of website authority with focus on entity clarity, independent references, author/editorial credibility, and reputation signals beyond just backlinks.
- Integrates existing evidence from various sources and avoids reducing authority to a single score unless defensible.
- Distinguishes between vendor/provider metrics (like DA/DR) and internally measured authority signals.
- Outlines clear guidance for comparative analysis with peer cohorts, and when to defer or deny an assessment due to insufficient evidence.
- Specifies use cases and boundaries relative to related skills (backlink-opportunities, eeat-review, etc.).
